# Accuminds Consulting FZCO

> Finance, compliance and automation consultancy for SMEs and free zone companies in the UAE, based in Dubai Silicon Oasis (IFZA).

Accuminds provides bookkeeping and accounting, UAE VAT and Corporate Tax compliance, e-invoicing readiness, part-time CFO advisory, MIS and management reporting, and AI-assisted accounting automation.

Contact: info@accumindsconsulting.ae · +971 50 98 67247 (phone and WhatsApp) · DSO - IFZA, IFZA Properties, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai, UAE

## Services

- [Bookkeeping & Accounting](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/services/bookkeeping-accounting-dubai/): Bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end close and financial statements.
- [VAT Services](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/services/vat-services-uae/): Registration, VAT returns, refunds, voluntary disclosures and deregistration.
- [Corporate Tax Services](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/services/corporate-tax-uae/): Registration, Corporate Tax returns, Small Business Relief and free zone reviews.
- [E-Invoicing Readiness](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/services/e-invoicing-uae/): Timelines, accredited service provider onboarding and invoice data readiness.
- [CFO Advisory](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/services/cfo-advisory-dubai/): Budgets, forecasts, cash-flow planning and board / investor packs.
- [MIS & Reporting](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/services/mis-reporting-dubai/): Management packs, KPIs, dashboards and variance analysis.
- [AI Accounting Automation](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/services/ai-accounting-automation-uae/): Invoice and receipt capture, reconciliation and approval workflows.

## Free tools

- [Free E-Invoice Readiness Checker](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/e-invoice-checker/): Check sample sales invoices against the UAE e-invoicing (PINT AE) mandatory fields in your browser, with a readiness score, gap list and PDF report. Runs in the browser; invoice files are not uploaded.

## Free tools and templates

- [Corporate Tax Filing Check](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/corporate-tax-check/): Answer up to five questions to see whether you must register and file for UAE Corporate Tax, and whether Small Business Relief may apply.
- [Free Monthly MIS Report Template](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/mis-report-template/): An Excel MIS pack for SMEs: P&L against budget, KPIs, working-capital days, a three-month cash outlook and commentary prompts.

## Guides

- [QuickBooks and UAE e-invoicing: connecting to an ASP](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/guides/quickbooks-e-invoicing-uae/): QuickBooks is not an accredited provider: how to connect through one, and what to ask before you sign.
- [Zoho Books UAE e-invoicing: setup and data checklist](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/guides/zoho-books-e-invoicing-uae/): Zoho is an accredited provider with e-invoicing built in: the setup steps and the data to fix first.
- [TallyPrime UAE e-invoicing: ASP setup and data checklist](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/guides/tally-e-invoicing-uae/): Tally is an accredited provider: preparing your TallyPrime masters and appointing Tally in EmaraTax.
- [Odoo and UAE e-invoicing: connectors and ASPs](https://www.accumindsconsulting.ae/guides/odoo-e-invoicing-uae/): Odoo is not an accredited provider: connector modules, choosing an ASP, and the data to fix first.
